ratchet.why: RFC-04: D-10a 的判定从『绝对阈值 80%/70%』改为『不得低于本文件登记的实测基线』。绝对目标保留为 M4/M8 里程碑目标，以 COVERAGE-PENDING 持续报告。
ratchet.rule: linesCovered >= current.linesCovered 且 branchesCovered >= current.branchesCovered（严格，无容差）；且 line >= current.line - EPSILON_PP 与 branch >= current.branch - EPSILON_PP（EPSILON_PP=0.10，只为吸收被插桩分母的抖动，不是授权降级）。

target.why: docs/41-testing-strategy.md D-10a 原文的 80%/70% 数值与含义均不变；变的只是它不再作为当下的判定线。

crossCheck.note: Second independent run. Covered counts are IDENTICAL (190 lines / 62 branches); the percentage moved 0.01pp only because the instrumented denominator changed (3734 -> 3740 valid lines, 1531 -> 1535 branches). This is exactly what EPSILON_PP=0.10 exists to absorb.

earlierMeasurement.whyDifferent: That run instrumented the same runner before t9 attempt 6 added 23 assertions (PetRuntimeLogicTests + AbiBaselineTests); the 8 pure-reflection ContractShapeTests executed almost no core code. Both numbers are real; the newer one supersedes it as the current scale.

note: Historical record of what the gate actually measured. NOT a target and NOT editable to make a run green - raising the floor is a human edit whose diff is the evidence of the increase (RFC-04 §4.3). 5.09% -> 80% is a project-level gap: M2 deliberately ships 32 pure-logic assertions (D-10b forbids unit tests that touch real OS/GPU/fs), and the remaining coverage is host/window/GPU/plugin behaviour that belongs to M4 behaviour and M8 hardening work.
